answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce the SYLLABUSQA dataset for course logistics-related QA... We also benchmarked the performance of several strong, LLM-based automated QA baselines on this dataset.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to course logistics-related questions

answer_2.quote: We report surface textual similarity using traditional metrics like ROUGE-L F1 and recent ones like BERTScore F1... We design a novel LLM-based (GPT-4) evaluation metric which we call Fact-QA...

answer_3.quote: We design a novel LLM-based (GPT-4) evaluation metric which we call Fact-QA, inspired by FActScore, to evaluate the factuality of predicted answers.
methods: atomic fact extraction and support checking

answer_4.quote: We (the authors) additionally perform a human evaluation to examine the factual similarity between the expert annotator-written answers and the annotator-written ground-truth answers, on 5% of the test set.
answer_4.guideline: assess if the factual information contained in the predicted answer is supported by the ground-truth answer (precision) and vice versa (recall)
